author: arusinoff
body:
Easily done in the memory battle:
1. Start the hunt
2. Look for the memory that looks like portal - If no portals found - do 1-2 other memories
3. When found, remove summons from spells, get buffs and ward spells
4. Get in, check enemies, in no Enlightened guys inside, flee and repeat step 4 till there will be.
5. Repeat till you will finish quest :) Could be done in 1 portal :) Just flee after you completed codex for 1 guy, and repeat till other one will be there :)

author: Looksees69
body:
Summoners are sorta the absolute worst for codexing

Little slots = lots of switching if the enemy has a big codex (draconian era)
Summons don't codex, summons kill too fast = less opertunity to finish codexing 

Switch to a warrior or mage class (only if you have one already, don't go out of your way to buy them (just yet)), remove any pets and you'll be able to codex in 1 go when you do find one. 

Alternatively remove summons and deal with the few slots, although attuner is really squishy.
